text: Use focused behavior, component and API fixtures promptly. Browser checks cover actual routing, hydration, storage, service-worker lifecycle, layout, keyboard focus and accessibility when relevant. Verify exact server/build identity and browser policy; mock or screenshot evidence alone never establishes integration. Deployment and physical-device evidence remain separate. For authorized UI implementation, search the project catalog or source before editing. Verify a working example for a reusable component, or record the gap and implement the first task-local solution. For UI review, exercise the changed journey and record what the user sees before and after the action. Read [Web development](references/web-development.md) for the catalog entry format, rendered review, server identity, failure states and browser evidence.
